notes: A 42-inch Toro TimeCutter zero-turn with a Briggs & Stratton 15.5 hp, 500 cc engine, two hydro transaxles and a 3 gal fuel tank. The parts catalogue covers serial numbers 400000000 and up.

gaps: The catalogue lists the engine as a Briggs & Stratton Professional engine without a model number, and gives no battery amp-hours or fuel tank capacity; engine size, horsepower and tank capacity are from the Toro product page.
The product page names the transmission Dual Hydrostatic HG-ZT2100; the catalogue lists the LH and RH hydro transaxle assemblies, so the HG-ZT2100 name is not claimed as a part.
Switch 110-6765 (qty 2) is listed only as 'Switch', so its job is not stated.
Bearing 138-9770 is listed with quantity 2 under spindle assembly 139-3214; no per-machine total is set.
The LED light kit 140-2056 is an accessory, so no headlight is claimed.
The product page gives no serial range for model 75748; the catalogue's serial 400000000 and up is used.
No years found; the catalogue gives a serial range, not a production year.
method: Toro TimeCutter 42in parts catalogue, Form 3446-923 Rev C, model 75748, serial 400000000 and up (toro.com/getpub/281591): pages 11, 13, 15 (drive), 23 (seat), 27 (engine), 29 (fuel), 31 (electrical), 33 (deck), 38 (accessories). Part numbers compared character by character.
Toro product page for model 75748 (toro.com/en/product/75748): engine brand Briggs and Stratton, 15.5 hp, 500 cc, fuel capacity 3 gal / 11.4 L, fuel type gasoline, 2 blades.
Toro catalogues for the 50 inch TimeCutter MR5075T and the HD ZX4800 are other models and were not used.

comps.spec: 12 V dry battery, 230 CCA, Toro part 105-1692 (catalogue page 31, qty 1)
Solenoid 117-1197 (qty 1), with cover 140-2080 and cap 140-2081 (catalogue page 31)
Two hydro transaxle assemblies: LH 139-7450 and RH 139-7451, qty 1 each (catalogue page 11); each has pump block 110-8561 (pages 13 and 15)
V-belt 139-2399 in the traction drive assembly (qty 1, page 11) and V-belt 119-8819 on the 42 inch deck (qty 1, page 33); the accessories page (page 38) also lists mower deck drive belt 79004
Ball bearing 138-9770, qty 2 within spindle assembly 139-3214 (catalogue page 33)
Ignition switch 137-4100 (qty 1), PTO switch 103-5221 (qty 1) and Switch 110-6765 (qty 2), catalogue page 31
Bail switch 82-2190 in seat assembly 147-5157 (catalogue page 23)
Blade fuse, 15 A, Toro part 109355, listed with wire harness 138-2521 (catalogue page 31)
Blade fuse, 25 A, Toro part 109102, listed with wire harness 138-2521 (catalogue page 31)
Fuel tank, 3 gal (11.4 L), gasoline (product page)
Blade 137-1999-03, qty 2, on the 42 inch deck (catalogue page 33)
Seat, 16 in, Toro part 139-5891, in seat assembly 147-5157 (catalogue page 23)
